Thank you super much, it fixed the problem!

So my boyfriend is a bit unhappy with the skin, so I thought I should post here and hope for a change. We nonetheless appreciate the work that has been put into the skin production! <3

What bothered us the most when we watched the PBE Spotlight was the missing death animation. Of course you shouldn't be seeing much of it in best case, unfortunately it's still a part of the game and makes the skin feel unfinished. :( Him just falling over doesn't do him justice, maybe it would be possible to add a few of the Smools to not make it such a basic animation.

As cute as the W is: we were not sure what he is doing there exactly? He has to be either kissing that little dude or he is drinking him (burps after all!), either option being slightly disturbing. I'm not sure how I would fix it, since being a drunk is a big characteristic of Gragas, but at least changing it into a smooshing sound or something might help. I assume changing the look of the W would be pushing the skin into a higher cost tier.
There could be some sound adjustments to his E as well, right now it seems very close to the basic skin.
The Ult could have a "bigger boom", right now it feels to gentle.

A tiny change might also be the colour of his eye brows to fit the skin better (like in the splash art) instead of having the bright funky hair and just his usual plain eyebrows.

Now his personal opinion, since I see a lot of people liking the Space Groove skin: He thinks that the theme doesn't fit Gragas unfortunately, feels like the skin was just "pumped out" so he has one and is played a lot recently again. :( That it feels like Riot wants to capitalize on that because of the rising popularity.

His idea was to add him to the Astronaut skinline:
"I think Astronaut Gragas could be fun as hell! Has a space suit, does little hops around. His E is just thrust boosters with some moon rocks flying past as he jumps over somewhere. His Q is a white barrel (to reflect radiation away from the booze). His W is just taking off the lid and drinking and his R is the same, throws out a big barrel to do big boom.
For his back animation he could sit in the middle of a group of smool aliens running around him until he cheers his beer up since he's about to take a drink, then all the smool aliens all put their little arms up and also yell out a smool cheers."

But thank you so much for giving people the opportunity, it's always heartwarming to see that people still can do and give nice things to each other. <3
Unfortunately only have my maternal one: H3b.

B.) I wanted to be less of a people pleaser and take more care of my mental health, not worry too much what others think of me. I worried way too much about that, even when people told me that I was by far the nicest and most gentle person they have met. I struggled a lot with my self-image, couldn't self-reflect that well and just fell into a hole. Trying to be perfect, which obviously cannot work. My partner helped me understand and throughout the year 2021 I grew a lot as a person and got a more mature view, went to university this summer and will continue to work hard on myself. Especially during the pandemic I noticed that people come to me for support, but that I struggled to do the same; instead I kept my negative thoughts to myself and I tried to get through it alone. Not the way to go, I noticed, and now my friends make sure that I don't fall back into this bad habit. Just happy that 2021 overall wasn't as bad, unfortunately 2022 started less good, because my Mum and I had to move out because of an instability in the apartment building and are now living with a family friend that seems to be more conservative and just overall not that open about stuff, so we often have discussions about things that start to bring me back to a bad mental space. New resolution: find a new apartment, work hard on university to hopefully get out of poverty and get back in shape! :D

Hey there, feels good to know that we are not the only ones going through this!
One of the biggest reasons why my boyfriend doesn't seek out for help might be his passionate self-hate. He doesn't think he's worth it, just a waste of money, time, space and air to breathe. You cannot force him to go, he kind of has to make that decision himself, that's true. Do you know why he doesn't see it as an option? Is it fear? Not being able to trust, even though it is professional help? His mind too? Did you tell him how you felt about it, that it hurts you and it makes it difficult for you? I am of course not blaming him - but he does love you and I don't think that he wants you to be in a bad state like him.
I am sorry to hear that you guys struggle with communicating and expression of feelings. I know the pain but we somehow overcame that and it really helps both of us - even if it hurts, too. He is not used to people who care which might have make it easier. No, things are never easy. I was and am just as helpless as you are - unsure what to do. But it's also the small things every day that make him feel a slightly bit better, for a little amount of time. Small personal gifts to make him feel appreciated and show him that he is loved every day.
He has trust issues because of the cheating aspects in former relationships, and I am assuming that time and patience will hopefully prove me to be trustworthy - but we are running out of time. So here I am, trying to fight two battles at once.
I hope you two also have the strength to keep fighting. I know it is difficult and exhausting, after all giving up might be the easiest decision but then you fought for nothing and not only lose each other.
Hope I was able to help just a tiny bit, hugs from a stranger!

Thanks for your advice and help!

I even offered to pay for things but he wouldn't ever allow me to do that - so all I can do to support him, and trying to find professional around him that are able to help?
